findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tfo_get_page, tfo_claims_check, tfo_send_brief · Private data: tfo_get_page, tfo_label_check, tfo_timeline, tfo_case_studies · Public sink: tfo_claims_check, tfo_request_call, tfo_send_brief · Destructive: tfo_search, tfo_get_page, tfo_case_studies, tfo_send_brief.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tfo_get_page, tfo_claims_check, tfo_send_brief · Private data: tfo_get_page, tfo_label_check, tfo_timeline, tfo_case_studies · Public sink: tfo_claims_check, tfo_request_call, tfo_send_brief · Destructive: tfo_search, tfo_get_page, tfo_case_studies, tfo_send_brief

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
